settings.title: Job statuses
settings.subtitle: Name your own job statuses. Each one counts as a standard status, so reports, automations and AI keep working.
settings.ownerOnly: Only the account owner can change statuses.
settings.fieldMapsHelp: Reports, automations and AI treat this status as the standard one you pick. It can't be changed once jobs use it.
settings.fieldNote: Require a note when moving a job here
settings.fieldRequiredHelp: Comma-separated field keys (for example permit_no). A job can't move here until they are filled in.
settings.fieldSlaHelp: Only for waiting and hold statuses. Uses the existing reminder and overdue alerts.
settings.archivedToast: Status archived. Jobs already using it keep it.

rules.title: Transition rules
rules.help: Optional. Once you add a rule, only the listed moves are allowed. With no rules, any move is allowed.
rules.empty: No rules: every move is allowed.

errors.labelTooLong: The name is too long (max 60 characters).
errors.labelTaken: Another status already has this name.
errors.keyInvalid: The key must start with a letter and use only a–z, 0–9 and underscores.
errors.keyTaken: Another status already uses this key.
errors.requiredFieldsInvalid: Use up to 10 unique field keys (letters, digits, underscores).
errors.slaNotSupported: A time limit only works with waiting and hold statuses.
errors.limitReached: You can have at most 40 active statuses.
errors.unchanged: The job is already in this status.
errors.transitionNotAllowed: This move isn't allowed for your role or from the current status.
errors.noteRequired: Add a short note (at least 3 characters).
errors.forbidden: You can only update jobs assigned to you.
errors.invalid_transition: This move isn't possible from the current status.
errors.slot_conflict: The time slot is no longer free.

starter.title: Trade starter statuses
starter.help: Ready-made statuses for the trade packs you've installed. Add only what you need; you can rename or archive them later.
starter.none: Install a trade pack to see its starter statuses here.
